g.text: Ten cosmetic-grade movement trails · layered light, refined materials, signature motifs and progressive dissipation
Iridescent silk ribbons · pearlescent edge lighting
Dense micro-particles · jewel sparks · depth of field
Volumetric wisps · layered translucent cloud · inner filaments
Glossy echo orbs · fading halos · temporal depth
Interwoven glass filaments · refractive edges · layered depth
Delicate luminous ornament · fine connecting threads · jeweled nodes
Faceted micro-crystals · icy caustics · drifting frost dust
Opalescent petals · floating floral fragments · delicate light threads
Nested translucent ellipses · refraction · drifting luminous nodes
Premium concept direction · Trail Effect defines form and material; tier heatmap defines hue; age defines opacity and dissipation.
All trails are residues behind the orb along recorded history. No forward projection, slash, weapon arc or attack burst.
